rules.name: Destructive Command Block
rules.rule: Commands matching 'rm -rf' or 'rm -fr' MUST trigger a high-priority 'ASK_USER' gate, regardless of agent mode (including YOLO).
rules.rationale: Prevents catastrophic substrate loss during high-velocity technical strikes.

rules.name: Remote Mutation Gate
rules.rule: Commands that fetch and execute remote code (e.g., 'curl | bash', 'npm install') MUST be audited by the Pilot.
rules.rationale: Ensures substrate sovereignty and prevents unauthorized logic injection from outside the Meta-Root.
